title: Kiritani Haruka — You Give Me Wings〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Haurka's Room

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I'm glad I was able to finish putting together our training schedules.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I was even able to come up with individualized plans for Tenma, Shinonome and myself, since the stages we'll each be doing are all different.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I couldn't have done this without MEIKO's help...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (But we don't have much time, so these schedules are pretty intense.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I don't even know if Tenma and Shinonome will agree to do this...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Oh, that reminds me...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hey, An? Sorry, I know it's late.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
<That's totally fine. Anyway, what's up?
You usually message me instead of calling like this.>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I wanted to ask you something.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm going to be competing in an event called “Shinobi Battle” with Tenma and Shinonome...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
<Yeah, I heard!
Akito sounded super stoked. “If we're in it, we're in it to win it!”>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I actually just came up with some training schedules that I think will help us win.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But I'd like to hear your opinion, since I feel that I may be asking too much of them.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
<Wait, you want my advice?
I don't really know a lot about this kind of stuff...>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But you're friends with both Tenma and Shinonome, right? I was hoping you could tell me more about how they train on a daily basis.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
<Oh, okay!
I should be able to help you there!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: In that case, I'll send over what I made now. If you don't mind taking a look at it...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
<No, wait!
Do we have to talk about this now?>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Huh? No, not necessarily...
Are you busy right now?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: <No, I just thought that we could chat in person!>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
<Are you free tomorrow after school?
If you are, wanna come over to the cafe?>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I'm having that meeting with Minori and the others to discuss how we're going to do our Shinobi Battle stream. But I should be free afterwards...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm meeting with the other to discuss a stream, but I should be able to head over once it's done. Would that be okay?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: <Okay! Then, we'll meet at the cafe once your meeting's finished!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Alright, sounds good.
The next day
Weekend Garage

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hello.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Welcome! Table for one?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
No, I'm meeting a friend.
She should be here already...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yes, she arrived here a little while ago, and got some cleaning in to boot.

rows.Speaker: Haruka & An
rows.Line:
Hehe.
Haha.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Here's some tea.
Sorry, this is sorta all we have, since we're closed right now.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That's okay. I'll gladly have this.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Mmm... This is nice...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'd heard the cafe would be closing for a while, but it doesn't really feel like it's been closed up.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah. We've still been using it, just as a training space.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Speaking of which...
I took a look at the training schedules you sent over.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: What did you think?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
They look really intense!
I totally get why you wanted to hear my opinion.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah, I had a feeling...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But they should work just fine!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Lemme start with Akito. He trains the hardest out of everyone on our team, so he's as tough as nails!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: If anything, he's the type who gets excited whenever he's faced with a difficult challenge!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: As for Tenma... One of my classmates does shows with him, and she's told me a lot about him!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: He's apparently been training really hard lately too.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: She said he can climb, or run, up walls or something now? Anyway, I don't think you have to worry about either of them.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I guess I got a little ahead of myself.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I mean, those two were training that day in order to make their dreams come true, after all.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Sorry for making you gather all this information for me, An.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
That's okay.
All I really had to do was ask a friend in class.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: If anything, I think it's good that you're being so careful and considerate about all this, Haruka.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Still, this is Akito and Tenma we're talking about. You really don't need to hold back for those two.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I know you're all friends, An, but I'm not sure you're allowed to say that.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Heehee.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (You're always like this...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (But I'm glad I asked you about this.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Thank you so much, An.)
